notes: Template for a separately managed group (plus track). Copy to cohorts/2026-plus.json and pass --cohort 2026-plus to every script. year: the course year, used by cross-year tables. default_plan false: the task READMEs carry no pre-filled issue links, so every issue is the student's own plan and the planning line is worded that way. exercises per task: the number of parts an issue could cover (1 for a single free-form assignment); the deadline is the cutoff at the end of the exercise day. discover.py fills deadline and exercises from the READMEs when it can; a value typed here wins.
